title: Findings file — knowledge-capture format
description: Machine-readable copy of the canonical schema at findings/README.md (findings/README.md is the authority; this file must not diverge). One file per task at findings/<TASKID>-<slug>.json. Immutable once the Orchestrator ratifies absorption.

task_id.description: managent task identifier — e.g. T129, T172. Must match the kanban task ID.

date.description: ISO-8601 date when the finding was produced — e.g. 2026-08-01.

model.description: Model that executed the task — e.g. DSPro, DSFlash, Fable, Consul.

claims.description: Claim status changes proposed by this task. Empty array when none are touched.

id.description: Claim ID as registered in CLAIMS.md §2, e.g. QA-027.

proposed_status.description: Proposed epistemic status. The (definition) pseudo-status is not valid.

rationale.description: One-sentence justification for the status change.

evidence_path.description: Path to evidence file (relative to repo root), typically a PROVENANCE.md.

new_rows.description: New CLAIMS.md rows proposed by this task. Omit or leave empty when none.

id.description: Proposed claim ID (must follow the CLAIMS.md §1 ID scheme).

depends_on.description: Edge list, same format as CLAIMS.md depends-on column.

notes.description: Extended notes — gaps, verification, next steps. Optional; prefer the evidence path for detail.
